content:
In addition to macOS 26.6, Apple is also rolling out important bug-fix updates for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8. Here's what you need to know.

macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 are finally here

After as many as seven Release Candidates, Apple has officially released macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8.

The build numbers for these final versions are identical to last week's Release Candidates:

  • macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 (23J620)
  • macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 (24G824)

Apple's release notes only state that these updates provide "important security fixes" and recommend that all users still on macOS Sonoma and macOS Sequoia install them.

Over the past few weeks, Apple has rolled out a number of security fixes for older system versions, many of which addressed WebKit vulnerabilities that could lead to the disclosure of users' data. As such, if you're still on macOS Sonoma or macOS Sequoia, it's highly recommended that you install these updates as soon as possible.

Update: Apple has now published the full security content for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8, detailing a combined total of more than 138 different vulnerabilities across both systems.

Are you still using macOS Sonoma or macOS Sequoia? Let us know in the comments.
